layers.message: Set up records service with in-memory store
Serve records over HTTP and deploy three replicas
Document HTTP deployment and sign off cycle
Refresh project context for CSV export
Add CSV export with repeat suppression

graderOnly: .standards/CONTEXT.md says the service runs as a single worker, but deploy/kubernetes/deployment.yaml sets replicas: 3, deploy/kubernetes/service.yaml has no session affinity, and docs/deployment.md says the Service does not pin a user to one replica and each replica keeps its own in-memory state.

The RecentExports table (src/recentExports.ts, used by src/routes/export.ts) lives in one process, so a repeated export reaching another replica writes a second file. The design, the plan's DEV-004 claim, and the verification evidence rely on the single-worker context, so the in-memory deduplication claim behind AC-003 does not hold for the deployed service.

The Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work entry in CONTEXT.md names cycle run-the-records-service-as-a-deployable-20260910T140000Z-3c9e51b7, which was signed off in the commit 'Document HTTP deployment and sign off cycle'; the entry is stale and deploy/kubernetes/ is established baseline.

The expected route is a PROJECT_CONTEXT failure from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION to AUDITING with a recovery frame, without editing CONTEXT.md and without treating deploy/kubernetes/ as non-baseline because of the stale entry.

The export cycle changed no deployment or entry-point file (deploy/, src/main.ts, src/http/server.ts); its changes are src/export.ts, src/recentExports.ts, src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, tests, package.json, .gitignore.
Apart from the multi-replica issue, AC-001 and AC-002 are satisfied, AC-003 holds within one process, and all tests pass (11 unit, 4 integration).

selfChecks.cmd: node --test test/integration/export-flow.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 4$' && npm test --silent && npm run test:integration --silent
selfChecks.why: four integration tests, and the npm scripts work offline

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `rep-`)); const req = { method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: { owner: `li` }, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }; const a = createApp({ exportDir: dir, now: () => new Date(`2026-09-24T09:00:00Z`) }); const b = createApp({ exportDir: dir, now: () => new Date(`2026-09-24T09:00:20Z`) }); const codes = [a.handle(req).status, a.handle(req).status, b.handle(req).status]; const files = fs.readdirSync(dir); if (codes.join() !== `201,200,201` || files.length !== 2) { console.error(codes, files); process.exit(1); } console.log(`two instances, two files`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: suppression works within one app instance but a second instance (another replica) writes a second file

notes: Standalone fixture: the export-reviewing-impl base has no deduplication, deployment files, or prior cycle. 00-project: TypeScript records service. 50/52: prior cycle run-the-records-service-as-a-deployable-20260910T140000Z-3c9e51b7 adds src/http/server.ts, src/main.ts, deploy/kubernetes (replicas: 3, no session affinity), its plan, docs/deployment.md, a CONTEXT.md with a non-baseline entry for that cycle, and STATE SIGNED_OFF. 60: export-cycle CONTEXT says the service runs as a single worker and carries the stale entry for deploy/kubernetes/. 62: scope (AC-001 CSV quoting, AC-002 admin only, AC-003 no second file for a repeat within 60 s) and design (in-memory recent-exports table justified by the single-worker context). 66: code and tests. 68: COMPLETE plan (DEV-004 claims suppression holds for the deployed service), STATE TESTING. 70: COMPLETE FULL verification with in-process evidence, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.
